name: FINVAL_F01_RATE_CONTRACT
stale: Retain existing stale/CAS envelope; refetch server state and require a deliberate user edit; never retry with a substituted hash.
create_clone: Server establishes unit + source lineage. A client marker is not proof for an existing historical row. Existing create adapter payloads unchanged; obtain canonical field data and save explicit edits under returned CAS/CSRF.
ambiguity_remediation: Create a verified Working Copy or request owner-reviewed provenance repair. No automatic migration.

legacy_snapshot_hash_hint.meaning: plain ProjectInputSet hash of the final reconciled saved snapshot, not a composite CAS token
legacy_snapshot_hash_hint.failure: Typed refusal before any UPDATE/INSERT if a supplied hash does not bind the exact final value, unit and lineage. The modern single/batch composite CAS writers are unchanged.
